_help: One entry per listing page. name: stable key (cursor seeded_<name>). label: the source as it shows in the Inbox. url: the listing. category: default category of its items. Optional: scope (CSS of the list container; default: main content), link_regex / exclude_regex (on the link url), wait_for (CSS to wait for), click (CSS list, e.g. a cookie button), settle_ms, min_text (default 25), min_links (default 2), max_items (default 40), locale (default el-GR), require_date (keep only links with a date next to them), mode "page" (no list: one item whenever the text of the page changes; with min_chars), enabled (default true). tested: what a real browser saw on the date given.
